content: authentik logout: /outpost.goauthentik.io/sign_out on the protected application host. Since 2023.2 signing out there terminates all user sessions within that outpost, but not sessions in other outposts or other protocols. Destroying only a local app session is not a sign-out: the next request re-authenticates silently from the still-valid authentik session cookie. Open issues #5427, #3471, #2023 show this is a repeated user-facing confusion.
